In 2018, Prof. Dr. Ovalı established NCT Inventors’ Workshop to help children engage with technology as creators, not merely consumers. tab0.title: Child Safety Comes First
tab0.subtitle: Physical and Digital Safety Standards
tab0.intro: Orbit Pix is designed to help children interact safely in both physical and digital environments, with safety at the heart of its design.
tab0.grid1Desc: The smooth outer shell has no sharp corners and is designed to reduce the risk of injury from accidental bumps.
tab0.grid2Desc: BPA-free, food-grade plastic components and environmentally friendly paints are used with child safety in mind.
tab0.grid3Desc: Orbit Pix is designed around voice communication rather than a camera, offering a natural and secure interaction experience.
tab0.grid4Desc: Personal data is securely stored on our encrypted servers located in Türkiye.
tab0.highlight: Orbit Pix is developed with a simple, intuitive, and user-friendly design that takes children’s everyday habits into account.

tab1.title: Natural Communication Experience
tab1.subtitle: AI-Powered Turkish Voice Interaction
tab1.intro: Children can speak with Orbit Pix naturally and fluently in Turkish, much like talking with a friend.
tab1.grid1Desc: The advanced microphone array filters classroom and household noise to better capture the child’s voice.
tab1.grid2Desc: A warm, natural-sounding voice designed to make words easy for children to hear and understand.
tab1.grid3Desc: The language model interprets incomplete or unconventional sentences and generates meaningful responses.
tab1.grid4Desc: Incoming and outgoing speech content passes through safeguards designed to keep interactions age-appropriate.
tab1.highlight: The AI voice system is optimized for clear, well-paced speech to support children’s language development.

tab2.title: Student Orbit Mobile App
tab2.subtitle: Mobile Management and Progress Tracking
tab2.intro: With the Student Orbit mobile app, parents can conveniently monitor their child’s progress and manage the Orbit Pix experience in one place.
tab2.grid1Desc: Basic Orbit Pix settings and the user experience can be managed easily through the mobile app.
tab2.grid2Desc: Parents can monitor their child’s usage patterns and progress through the app.
tab2.grid3Desc: The student’s grade level and content preferences can be updated in the app as needed.
tab2.grid4Desc: Parents can conveniently manage their child’s Orbit Pix experience in one app.
tab2.highlight: The Student Orbit mobile app allows parents to monitor and manage Orbit Pix usage from one place.

tab3.title: Engineering Expertise from Türkiye
tab3.subtitle: R&D and Engineering Capabilities
tab3.intro: Orbit Pix was designed in Türkiye by NCT Robotik engineers, who also carried out its research and development.
tab3.grid1Desc: A custom PCB designed at our R&D center to manage power and sensor-reading cycles.
tab3.grid2Desc: Stable embedded software enables rapid communication between sensors and motor drivers.
tab3.grid3Desc: A modular internal chassis designed to make hardware servicing quick and straightforward.
tab3.grid4Desc: Our manufacturing processes are carried out in partnership with POLO Otomasyon, drawing on its extensive industrial automation experience.
tab3.highlight: Orbit Pix is engineered by NCT Robotik, with manufacturing supported by our experienced industrial automation partner, POLO Otomasyon.

tab4.title: Long Battery Life
tab4.subtitle: Battery and Charging Performance
tab4.intro: Orbit Pix offers up to 5.5 hours of use on a single charge. With an approximately one-hour charging time, it is quickly ready to use again.
tab4.grid1Desc: Provides up to 5.5 hours of use per charge for daily learning and interaction.
tab4.grid2Desc: Ready for use again after approximately one hour of charging.
tab4.grid3Desc: Battery performance is designed to support everyday use at home and in learning environments.
tab4.grid4Desc: Balances a short charging time with extended use.
tab4.highlight: With approximately one hour of charging and up to 5.5 hours of use, Orbit Pix supports learning and interaction throughout the day.

tab5.title: Continuously Updated Software
tab5.subtitle: Wireless Updates and Cloud Infrastructure
tab5.intro: The NCT Robotik software team continuously improves Orbit Pix. Two years of software updates are included with purchase, with supported content and features delivered wirelessly at no extra cost during that period.
tab5.grid1Desc: Supported operating-system and AI updates are included in the product price for the first two years.
tab5.grid2Desc: New curriculum-aligned lessons and educational materials are regularly added to Orbit Pix through software updates.
tab5.grid3Desc: The parent mobile app makes it easy to manage student usage and Orbit Pix settings.
tab5.grid4Desc: Security patches are installed quietly in the background to help protect the system against software vulnerabilities.
tab5.highlight: Orbit Pix receives supported updates at no additional cost for two years. Afterward, it continues to work with its existing features without requiring a subscription.

kvkk.title: Personal Data Protection Notice (KVKK)
kvkk.subtitle: Your rights, how your data is processed, and the declaration of explicit consent under the Personal Data Protection Law.
kvkk.intro: Under Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK), your personal data may be processed by İsmail OVALI / NCT DANIŞMANLIK in its capacity as data controller.
kvkk.section1Title: 1. Purposes of Processing Your Personal Data
section1Items: Providing technical service and warranty support
Carrying out accounting and invoicing procedures
Conducting promotional campaigns and information activities (where explicit consent has been given)
kvkk.section4Title: 4. Methods and Legal Grounds for Collecting Personal Data
kvkk.section4Desc: Your personal data may be collected electronically or physically through the website, order forms, email correspondence, telephone conversations, technical service requests, and payment systems.
kvkk.section5Desc: Your personal data may be transferred to the following parties under the conditions prescribed by applicable legislation and Articles 8 and 9 of the KVKK:
section5Items: Financial advisors and accounting service providers
kvkk.section6Title: 6. Storage and Security of Personal Data
kvkk.section6Desc: Your personal data is protected by firewalls, access control systems, and encryption methods. At the end of the retention period, data is deleted, destroyed, or anonymized.
kvkk.section7Desc: Under Article 11 of Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698, you have the following rights concerning your personal data:
section7Items: To learn whether your personal data is being processed
To request information if your personal data has been processed
To learn the purpose of processing and whether the data is used in line with that purpose
To know the third parties to whom your personal data is transferred, in Türkiye or abroad
To request correction of incomplete or inaccurate personal data
To request deletion or destruction of personal data under the conditions stipulated by the KVKK
To request notification of correction, deletion, or destruction to third parties to whom the data has been transferred
To object to a result against you arising exclusively from automated analysis of processed data
To request compensation for damages arising from unlawful processing of personal data
kvkk.section8Desc: You may submit your requests under the KVKK via the following contact channel:
kvkk.section8Resolution: Your applications will be concluded free of charge as soon as possible and within 30 (thirty) days at the latest, depending on the nature of the request.
kvkk.section9Desc: İsmail OVALI / NCT DANIŞMANLIK reserves the right to amend this Notice when deemed necessary. The updated notice will take effect on the date it is published on the website.
kvkk.guarantee: NCT Robotik upholds the principles of data protection to the highest degree within the constitutional guarantees of the Republic of Türkiye.
